LanguageData.UGCPatch_CooldownHint: Applies to the cooldown inflicted by directed extraction (the mod default is 1 day). Set it to 0 to remove the cooldown entirely.
LanguageData.UGCPatch_ExtractionHoursHint: Pressing "Extract gene" in the console no longer stores the gene instantly. Instead a timed job runs: a progress bar is shown above the machine, and only when it reaches zero is the gene actually extracted and the pawn automatically ejected. Set it to 0 to disable the timer and restore the original instant extraction.
LanguageData.UGCPatch_ArchiteSilverHint: Silver charged for each archite gene newly added by an injection. The mod default is 10,000 silver each (slider step 100). Ordinary genes are still charged by complexity (300 silver per point), and genes the pawn already has are free. Set it to 0 to remove the archite surcharge.\n\nPaying with warehouse points still uses the mod's 9,000 points per gene and is not affected by this setting.
LanguageData.UGCPatch_ResetDefaultsDesc: Restores all three settings above: extraction cooldown 1 day, extraction job duration 6 hours, archite gene 10,000 silver each.
LanguageData.UGCPatch_AutoExtractionDesc: When the occupant's extraction cooldown expires, automatically queue them to enter the compiler again (colonists walk in on their own; prisoners are carried in by a hauler). The extraction itself is still started manually from the console.
LanguageData.UGCPatch_ExtractionJobStarted: Extraction job started: {0}. Estimated duration {1}. The pawn will be ejected automatically when it finishes.
LanguageData.UGCPatch_ExtractionJobDone: Extraction job complete: gene {0} was extracted from {1}; ejecting automatically.
LanguageData.UGCPatch_ExtractionJobFailed: Extraction job failed: the gene could no longer be extracted when the job finished.
LanguageData.UGCPatch_ExtractionJobAborted: Extraction job cancelled: nobody is inside the machine any more.
LanguageData.UGCPatch_ExtractionBusy: An extraction job is already running ({1} left); {0} cannot be extracted until it finishes.
LanguageData.UGCPatch_ForceEjectConfirm: The universal gene compiler is running an extraction job: {0} ({1} left).\n\nForcing the eject will cancel the job and lose its progress, and the pawn will be ejected next to the machine. Force eject?
LanguageData.UGCPatch_NoNutrition: No nutrition stored - the occupant is starving.
